study: Bounded Hardest follow-up after unsuccessful first validation
control: Frozen pre-strengthening Hardest vs unchanged Harder
analysis: 100000 whole-pair bootstrap resamples; common resampling indices for before, after, and change
successCriteria: Revised Hardest's adjusted Medium-partner win interval lies above50%
Its adjusted paired Medium-partner improvement interval lies abovezero
The whole-team Hardest-to-Harder step remains supported
Medium, Hard, and Harder retain their previous behavior
excludedFromFinalInference: First validation seed20261221, reused only for three bounded follow-up development trials
stoppingRule: Finish all500pairs in each of four cases, regardless of interim outcomes; no retuning or optional extension
limitations: Bootstrap coverage is approximate. No joint family-coverage claim across prior studies, both metrics, or the whole research history. This experiment cannot establish mathematically perfect hidden-information play.
